offset.description: Offset of the first item returned in the collection.

nextOffset.description: Next offset to get next page of data based off current pageSize and offset, if available.

lightspeedPaymentId.description:
Unique identifier assigned by Lightspeed to the payment, derived from Adyen's PSP reference. 
This alphanumeric code uniquely identifies each payment or modification request, 
including refunds. For more information, see Adyen's documentation: 
https://help.adyen.com/knowledge/payments/payment-basics/what-is-a-psp-reference-number

uuid.description:
The internal UUID of the payment. This value may not be unique in scenarios involving Pay-at-Table, partial, or split payments, 
where multiple payment transactions can share the same reference and/or POS Order Id
For a guaranteed unique identifier for each Lightspeed Payments transaction, use the `lightspeedPaymentId` field which is based off Adyen PSP ID.

reference.description: The alphanumeric reference of the payment.

createdDate.description: The date and time the payment was created.

captureDate.description: The date and time the payment was captured.

financial-apiLSPaymentStatus.description: The statuses for a Lightspeed Payments transaction.
